title: Package Source Manifest -- packages/<package>/manifest.yaml
description: SDD-R004 §4 Package Identity, authored alongside the package's Engineering Knowledge Objects. Not one of the seven schemas ENGINE-TASK-000002 names explicitly, but required supporting infrastructure for the Reference Compiler (ENGINE-TASK-000004) to produce the runtime manifest.json SDD-R004 §8 describes -- a package cannot compile without declaring its own identity.

release_date.description: Pinned, source-controlled release date -- not derived from wall-clock build time, so compiled packages remain byte-for-byte reproducible (SDD-R004 §7) regardless of when the compiler happens to run.

package_type.description: SDD-R004 §3. Checked against the known list by the validator (soft, extensible).

dependencies.description: SDD-R004 §14. Circular dependencies are prohibited (checked by the validator across all installed packages).
